preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= N <= 100000 and 2 <= M <= 100000 for N, M in testcases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N (friends) and M (roads) are between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= K <= M for K, M in testcases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the target road index K is between 1 and M inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A <= N and 1 <= B <= N and A != B for A, B, N in testcases)
preconditions.description: Road endpoints A and B are valid friend indices distinct from each other.

preconditions.expression: all(C >= 1 and C <= 10**9 for C in testcases)
preconditions.description: Road lengths C are positive integers up to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(len(roads) == M and len(set((min(u,v), max(u,v)) for u,v,_ in roads)) == M for roads, M in testcases)
preconditions.description: The graph contains exactly M unique edges with no self-loops or multiple edges between the same pair.

preconditions.expression: all(is_connected(N, roads) for N, roads in testcases)
preconditions.description: The road network is connected for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(len(lines) == T and len(lines[i].split()) == 2 for i, lines in enumerate(testcase_outputs))
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, each with two space-separated values.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(float(parts[0]) - dist_from_A) < 1e-5 and abs(float(parts[1]) - max_dist) < 1e-5 for parts, dist_from_A, max_dist in output_values)
postconditions.description: The printed values match the optimal distance from A and the minimized maximum distance to 5 decimal places.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= dist_from_A <= road_length and dist_from_A + dist_from_B == road_length for dist_from_A, dist_from_B, road_length in optimal_solutions)
postconditions.description: The chosen point P lies on the K-th road, and the distance from A plus distance from B equals the road length.

postconditions.expression: all(max_dist == min(max(dist(i, P) for i in friends) for P in road_K) for max_dist, road_K, friends in optimal_solutions)
postconditions.description: The reported maximum distance is the minimum possible value of the maximum distance from any friend to a point P on the K-th road.

postconditions.expression: all(dist_from_A == min(d for d in valid_distances) for dist_from_A, valid_distances in optimal_solutions)
postconditions.description: If multiple points P achieve the minimum maximum distance, the one with the smallest distance from A is chosen.
